Running the unit tests across `encryption`, `config`, `fileutil`, `handler`, and `storage`.
Running the full test suite (`go test ./...`) inside the task environment.
I have implemented the `encryption` package and integrated streaming AES-256-GCM encryption into the configuration, file naming utilities, and dump handler pipeline on branch `feat/encryption`:

1. **`encryption` Package ([encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/encryption.go), [config.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/config.go), [encryption_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/encryption_test.go))**:
   - [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/encryption.go#L36-L47) validates 32-byte keys and wraps [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/encryption.go#L28) on invalid key lengths.
   - [`(*Encryptor).EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/encryption.go#L50-L67) performs streaming AES-256-GCM encryption in chunks up to 64KB (`0x4F 0x44` magic + `0x01` version header, 4-byte big-endian chunk length prefix, unique 12-byte random nonce, ciphertext + 16-byte GCM tag, 4-byte zero sentinel, and 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 over all chunk bytes between the header and sentinel), with idempotent `Close()`.
   - [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/encryption.go#L198-L221) lazily validates the header, decrypts chunks, verifies the trailing HMAC-SHA256, and reports errors for invalid headers, unsupported versions, integrity failures, wrong keys, and truncated streams during `Read`.
   - [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/config.go#L24-L32), [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/config.go#L75-L81), and [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/encryption/config.go#L133-L202) support case-insensitive key sources (`env`, `file`, `literal`, `derive`), enforce required and mutually exclusive fields, and load or deterministically derive 32-byte keys.

2. **Job Configuration & File Naming ([job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/config/job.go), [filenutil.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/fileutil/filenutil.go), [storage.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/storage/storage.go))**:
   - Added `Encryption` (`encryption.Config`) and [`Job.Encrypted()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/config/job.go#L136-L138) to [`config.Job`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/config/job.go#L49-L63), and exported [`Job.Validate()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/config/job.go#L113-L130) to run encryption config validation.
   - Updated [`fileutil.EnsureFileSuffix`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/fileutil/filenutil.go#L30-L46) and [`fileutil.EnsureFileName`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/fileutil/filenutil.go#L48-L51) to accept `shouldEncrypt bool` before `unique` and append `.enc` after `.gz` idempotently.

3. **Handler Pipeline ([jobhandler.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/handler/jobhandler.go), [jobhandler_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/handler/jobhandler_test.go))**:
   - Updated [`storageReadWriteCloser`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/handler/jobhandler.go#L31-L65) to accept `encryptor *encryption.Encryptor` and chain `gzip.NewWriter` into `encryptor.EncryptWriter`.
   - Updated [`(*JobHandler).save`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-1vk2bcdy/handler/jobhandler.go#L68-L162) to fail-fast by validating and loading the encryption key before any dumper or storage operations.
